courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計
related.transfer: 可遷移「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」與「烘烤程序與氫出氣的時間行為」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；渦輪分子泵與真空計的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S" and "Bakeout procedure and the time behaviour of hydrogen outgassing" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦出氣率、傳導率、金屬密封、烘烤與壓力量測構成的 10⁻¹¹ mbar 腔體工程；渦輪分子泵與真空計則以葉片動量傳遞、壓縮比與前級、轉子工程，以及從 1000 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar 的量測鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on outgassing, conductance, metal seals, bakeout and pressure measurement that make a 10⁻¹¹ mbar chamber; Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges centres on blade momentum transfer, compression and backing, rotor engineering, and the measurement chain from 1000 to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「腔壁的氣體來源」與「轉子葉片與氣體分子」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到渦輪分子泵與真空計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Gas sources at the chamber wall” and “Rotor blades and gas molecules”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超高真空腔體建置
history.text: 1950 年 Bayard 與 Alpert 把離子真空計的收集極改成細絲，第一次量到 10⁻⁸ Torr 以下的壓力，Alpert 隨後在西屋建立了全金屬、可烘烤的超高真空系統；1958 年 Varian 推出濺射離子泵，1962 年 Wheeler 與 Carlson 在 Varian 發明刀口加銅墊片的 ConFlat 法蘭，奠定今天的標準零件體系。1990 年代末 CERN 的 Benvenuti 等人發展 NEG 薄膜鍍層以供大型加速器使用。如今超高真空腔體是表面科學、分子束磊晶、加速器、光學原子鐘與重力波干涉儀的共同基礎，LIGO 的 4 km 真空管即是世界上最大的超高真空系統之一。
history.textEn: In 1950 Bayard and Alpert replaced the ion-gauge collector with a thin wire and measured below 10⁻⁸ Torr for the first time, and Alpert then built all-metal bakeable ultrahigh-vacuum systems at Westinghouse; Varian introduced the sputter-ion pump in 1958, and in 1962 Wheeler and Carlson at Varian invented the knife-edge, copper-gasket ConFlat flange that defines today's standard component system. In the late 1990s Benvenuti and colleagues at CERN developed NEG thin-film coatings for large accelerators. Ultrahigh-vacuum chambers now underpin surface science, molecular-beam epitaxy, accelerators, optical atomic clocks and gravitational-wave interferometers, LIGO's 4 km beam tubes being among the largest ultrahigh-vacuum systems in the world.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「極限壓力：出氣率、抽速與 p = Q/S」到「從抽氣曲線到驗收與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ultimate pressure: outgassing, pumping speed and p = Q/S" through "From pump-down curve to acceptance and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
